'''Ultimate Legacy''' is the fourth of four releases of [[Virtual Block 7]], a legacy virtual expansion. Its text is official as of 16 December 2011.<ref name="pdf" /> The release has 22 cards: 12 Dark Side and 10 Light Side.

== Discrepancies ==
* [[Hindsight (V)]] is printed twice in the release PDF.<ref name="pdf" />
* Printed as Floating Refinery (V); later released as [[Tibanna Floating Refinery]].<ref name="pdf" /><ref name="dl">[https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/blob/d4e661ec735dcb111266fbda98704f2181e1cfab/DarkLegacy.json DarkLegacy.json] (swccg-card-json legacy card data). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020183346/https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/d4e661ec735dcb111266fbda98704f2181e1cfab/DarkLegacy.json Internet Archive].</ref>
* Printed as Cyborg Commander's Lightsabers; later released as [[Grievous' Lightsabers]].<ref name="pdf" /><ref name="dl" />
* The alternate-image version [[Mace Windu, Master Of The Order (AI)]] on the [[Virtual Block 7]] card list is not in this release PDF.<ref name="pdf" />
